newsitem.title: ITALY: Saes Getters Q3 1996 net profit slips.
newsitem.headline: Saes Getters Q3 1996 net profit slips.

text.p: Italian electronic component maker Saes Getters said it posted third quarter 1996 net profit of 4.58 billion lire against 5.58 billion lire in the year-ago period.
Third quarter net profit per ordinary and savings share was equal to 195.2 lire against a year-ago 279.2 lire.
In the first nine months of this year net profit fell to 13.61 billion lire from a previous 17.23 billion, a company statement said.
Third quarter turnover rose 2.1 percent to 45.9 billion lire from a year-ago 44.9 billion lire. The company said turnover had been impacted by the lira's appreciation.
Third quarter net profit had been affected by extraordinary costs, such as some 400 million lire in amortisation for the company's listing on Nasdaq.
